scene: The brass sidecar rattles smoothly past cavernous depot shelves into darkness.
beats: Warm saxophone music bursts from the speaker as the bike skids to a halt, letting you step directly into Midnight Radio Repair's glowing doorway.
The courier beeps pleasantly, hands you a spare vacuum tube, and pulls up beside the workbench of Midnight Radio Repair.
Inside lies a glowing frequency chart; folding it up, you step off onto the rug inside Midnight Radio Repair as the engine cuts.
picture: Pixel art flat side view. On a dark street line, a motorcycle with attached brass sidecar speeds rightward. On the far left, a sleek robot courier steers. Centre, the player sits bundled in the sidecar beside a copper dial. To the right, a latched glove box. Depot shelves blur past outside.
